name: Buttery Noodles with Cheese
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: Dry linguine or Spaghetti (enough for 2 people)
Goat cheese (2 pats of butter worth)—Parmesan is an acceptable substitute

steps: Fill pot with enough water for 2 servings of linguine.
Put pot over high heat, and add vegetarian bouillon cube.
As soon as the water boils, add linguine and textured vegetable protein.
When the linguine is done, pour out most of the water, so that there is approximately an inch left.
Add butter, cheese, chopped tomato, and herbs.
Crush in garlic cloves and add to pot
Stir frequently until it is of desired thickness.
